tasks.title: Flash usage
tasks.solution: Share = 100·s/cap. 450 KB on an F411: 100·450/480 = 93.8 %; 470 KB — 97.9 %. More than 100 % — the linker will report an overflow of the FLASH1 region (on the F405 it is 992 KB, on the F722 — AXIM_FLASH1, 480 KB).

tasks.title: Will one more option fit
tasks.solution: Allowed: 0.95·cap = 456 KB on an F411. Remainder = 0.95·cap − s − a: with 420 KB and a 20 KB option — 16 KB; with 440 KB and 20 KB — −4 KB, meaning the build still fits in FLASH1 but there is no margin left for the next release.
